resources.string: See which countries your connection goes through
Turn on Tor in privacy settings to see the route.
Tor is still building a route. Try again in a moment.
Two nodes on this route are in the same country: %1$s.
The route won\'t pass through the same country twice. An extra safeguard: connecting may take a bit longer, and your routes will look a little less like those of other Tor users.

Tor deliberately keeps the entry node for a few months because that makes you harder to track. The middle and exit change regularly. Node countries come from the IPFire Location database (CC BY-SA 4.0) shipped with Tor.
